Navratri festival preparations and puja guidelines

The Shardiya Navratri festival is set to begin on October 11. Preparations include gathering necessary puja samagri (worship materials) for those observing fasts. Guidelines are being provided for performing quick puja rituals and kalash sthapana (pot installation) during the festival, even for those with limited time.
